Notes and quick observations:
- q4 runs consistently cheapest per-token but p90 instability on T4 and long seq.
- kv-cache reduces per-request work for multi-turn; need microbench for cache-fill cost.
- Batched-sync good for steady throughput but p90 tail increases with queue depth. async batching looked promising (RV-009).
